name: adk-dart-architecture
description: Explains how the ADK Dart & Flutter monorepo and runtime internals fit together: BaseNode, Workflow, NodeRunner, Runner, LlmFlow processors, Context and Event streams, part / part of modularized subsystems, domain entrypoint barrels, Web-safe (adk_core.dart) vs VM (adk_dart.dart) boundaries, and adk-python / adk-web parity conventions. Use when answering "how does X work" about ADK Dart internals, deciding where a new class or export belongs, modifying core runtime files, or porting upstream adk-python / adk-web changes. Don't use for assembling an agent from public APIs (use adk-dart-agent-builder) or building Flutter UI screens (use flutter-adk-ui-builder).
